name: allinluna
description: A layered execution runtime that compiles goals into Coordinators, Task Lanes, WorkUnits, and typed handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Compile a goal, plan, active run, or research route into an executable vNext task graph.
interface.longDescription: All in Luna provides one public Skill over the vNext runtime. A Global Coordinator releases independent Task Lanes; each Lane recursively schedules bounded WorkUnits and returns typed artifacts and handoffs. Workflow Packs stay outside Core and legacy inputs are read-only imports.
defaultPrompt: Highest priority: a logical LocalDispatchIntent is not yet a HostAction. Resolve it through the HostAdapter to an exact physical HostAction or a lane-direct-work/v1 plan. After resolution, treat HostAction.tool as an exact opcode and invoke it only with frozen arguments; never translate or substitute it. A top_level_task never falls back to a subagent, current-thread, or direct execution. Ingest raw receipts and preserve actual_tool, actual_capability, and action_contract_hash. Lane-direct completion requires a real verified work-handoff/v1.
Use All in Luna to compile this goal, existing plan, active run, or route packet into a RunIntent and TaskGraph, then execute it through the vNext runtime.

Resolve resources in this order: explicit user request, Task/WorkUnit override, user preference, Pack capability, deployment/host capability, then the current session or host default; preserve requested, resolved, and actual host receipt evidence separately.
